**autoapply is now a desktop app.** Install it, open **autoapply** from your Start menu or app launcher, and do everything from one window. The command line still works alongside it.

## Download

| Platform | File | Install |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows 11** | `autoapply-0.2.0-windows.zip` | Extract the zip, open a terminal in the folder, and run `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1` |
| **Linux** (Arch, plus any distro) | `autoapply-0.2.0-linux.tar.gz` | `tar xzf autoapply-0.2.0-linux.tar.gz && cd autoapply-0.2.0-linux && ./install.sh` |
| Python users | `autoapply-0.2.0-py3-none-any.whl` | `uv tool install autoapply-0.2.0-py3-none-any.whl` |

The installer adds shortcuts: the Start menu and desktop on Windows, your app launcher on Linux. Upgrading from 0.1.0 keeps your workspace, settings and job history.

## The app

- **Postings.** Find new postings from your job boards or add one by URL. Tick the ones to apply to, and see each posting's status and history.
- **Apply.**
  - Start a run, choosing whether the browser is visible, whether it's a practice run, and how many applications to do.
  - Follow the live activity log, and stop the run at any time.
- **When it needs you**, the app chimes, sends a desktop notification and opens a dialog:
  - **Essays and unknown questions:** type an answer, pick an option, fill it in the browser yourself, skip the question, or skip the posting. You can save an answer so the same question is answered automatically next time.
  - **Before submitting:** a review of everything it filled in.
  - **CAPTCHAs:** solve it in the browser, then continue.
  - **Unsupported portals:** apply by hand, then record whether you applied.
- **Your profile.** Upload your resume PDF, edit your details (invalid YAML is rejected before it's saved), and rebuild your profile.
- **Settings.** Edit job boards and filters, check your setup, and download Chromium.

The interface follows your system's light or dark theme. It opens in its own Edge, Chrome or Chromium window with no browser toolbars, and closing the window quits the app.

## Other changes

- New commands: `autoapply gui` (with `--no-window` and `--self-test`) and `autoapply-gui`.
- When a run is stopped, the posting in progress goes back to the queue.
- Tests now include an end-to-end GUI test. A real browser drives the app through a complete application and answers its dialogs.
